character: A two-mountain resort in Vermont's Mad River Valley (Lincoln Peak and Mount Ellen, linked by a long chairlift), owned by Alterra Mountain Company, with a mix of groomed runs and natural-snow tree and steep terrain.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at Lincoln Peak. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: Not researched in this build (web-search budget exhausted). No 2026-27 opening or closing date is on file as of 2026-09-28 — check the official site. Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

driveFromIthaca.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-79/I-88 to Albany, I-87 N to Exit 20, NY-149/US-4 to Rutland, US-4 E to Killington, then VT-100 N to Warren); not a routing-service result. Winter conditions on VT-100 add time; mountain-gap shortcuts may be closed or poor in winter.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (I-89 S to Exit 10 (Waterbury), then VT-100 S via Waitsfield to Warren); not a routing-service result. Closest airport with scheduled airline service (Piste reference, confirm).
